1.sahih_international: The Prophet frowned and turned away
1.muhammad_sarwar: He frowned and then turned away
1.mohsin_khan: (The Prophet (Peace be upon him)) frowned and turned away,

2.sahih_international: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
2.pickthall: Because the blind man came unto him.
2.yusuf_ali: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting).
2.shakir: Because there came to him the blind man.
2.muhammad_sarwar: from a blind man who had come up to him.
2.mohsin_khan: Because there came to him the blind man (i.e. 'Abdullah bin Umm-Maktum, who came to the Prophet (Peace be upon him) while he was preaching to one or some of the Quraish chiefs).
2.arberry: that the blind man came to him.

3.sahih_international: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
3.pickthall: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
3.yusuf_ali: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-
3.shakir: And what would make you know that he would purify himself,
3.muhammad_sarwar: You never know. Perhaps he wanted to purify himself,
3.mohsin_khan: But what could tell you that per chance he might become pure (from sins)?
3.arberry: And what should teach thee? Perchance he would cleanse him,

4.sahih_international: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
4.pickthall: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?
4.yusuf_ali: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him?
4.shakir: Or become reminded so that the reminder should profit him?
4.muhammad_sarwar: or receive some (Quranic) advice which would benefit him.
4.mohsin_khan: Or that he might receive admonition, and that the admonition might profit him?
4.arberry: or yet remember, and the Reminder profit him.

5.sahih_international: As for he who thinks himself without need,
5.pickthall: As for him who thinketh himself independent,
5.yusuf_ali: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,
5.shakir: As for him who considers himself free from need (of you),
5.mohsin_khan: As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,

6.shakir: To him do you address yourself.

7.sahih_international: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
7.pickthall: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).
7.yusuf_ali: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding).
7.shakir: And no blame is on you if he would not purify himself
7.muhammad_sarwar: though you will not be questioned even if he never purifies himself.
7.mohsin_khan: What does it matter to you if he will not become pure (from disbelief, you are only a Messenger, your duty is to convey the Message of Allah).
7.arberry: though it is not thy concern, if he does not cleanse himself.

8.sahih_international: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
8.pickthall: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose
8.yusuf_ali: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly,
8.shakir: And as to him who comes to you striving hard,
8.muhammad_sarwar: As for the one who comes to you earnestly (striving for guidance).
8.mohsin_khan: But as to him who came to you running.
8.arberry: And he who comes to thee eagerly

9.muhammad_sarwar: and who has fear of God,
9.mohsin_khan: And is afraid (of Allah and His Punishment),

10.shakir: From him will you divert yourself.
10.mohsin_khan: Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another,
10.arberry: to him thou payest no heed.

11.sahih_international: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
11.pickthall: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,
11.yusuf_ali: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:
11.shakir: Nay! surely it is an admonishment.
11.mohsin_khan: Nay, (do not do like this), indeed it (these Verses of this Quran) are an admonition,
11.arberry: No indeed; it is a Reminder

12.sahih_international: So whoever wills may remember it.
12.pickthall: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,
12.yusuf_ali: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance.
12.shakir: So let him who pleases mind it.
12.muhammad_sarwar: so let those who want to follow its guidance do so.
12.mohsin_khan: So whoever wills, let him pay attention to it.

13.yusuf_ali: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour,
13.muhammad_sarwar: (This Quran) is also recorded in honorable books,
13.mohsin_khan: (It is) in Records held (greatly) in honour (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz).

14.yusuf_ali: Exalted (in dignity), kept pure and holy,

15.muhammad_sarwar: by the hands of the noble, virtuous,

17.sahih_international: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.
17.yusuf_ali: Woe to man! What hath made him reject Allah;
17.shakir: Cursed be man! how ungrateful is he!
17.muhammad_sarwar: May (the disbelieving) human being be condemned! What makes him disbelieve?
17.mohsin_khan: Be cursed (the disbelieving) man! How ungrateful he is!
17.arberry: Perish Man! How unthankful he is!

18.sahih_international: From what substance did He create him?
18.pickthall: From what thing doth He create him?
18.yusuf_ali: From what stuff hath He created him?
18.shakir: Of what thing did He create him?
18.muhammad_sarwar: From what has God created him?
18.mohsin_khan: From what thing did He create him?
18.arberry: Of what did He create him?

19.sahih_international: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
19.pickthall: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,
19.yusuf_ali: From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions;
19.shakir: Of a small seed; He created him, then He made him according to a measure,
19.muhammad_sarwar: He created him from a living germ. He determined his fate
19.mohsin_khan: From Nutfah (male and female semen drops) He created him, and then set him in due proportion;
19.arberry: Of a sperm-drop He created him, and determined him,

20.sahih_international: Then He eased the way for him;
20.pickthall: Then maketh the way easy for him,
20.yusuf_ali: Then doth He make His path smooth for him;
20.shakir: Then (as for) the way-- He has made it easy (for him)
20.muhammad_sarwar: and made the path of guidance easy for him to follow.
20.mohsin_khan: Then He makes the Path easy for him;
20.arberry: then the way eased for him,

21.sahih_international: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
21.pickthall: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;
21.yusuf_ali: Then He causeth him to die, and putteth him in his grave;
21.shakir: Then He causes him to die, then assigns to him a grave,
21.muhammad_sarwar: Then He caused him to die and be buried
21.mohsin_khan: Then He causes him to die, and puts him in his grave;
21.arberry: then makes him to die, and buries him,

22.sahih_international: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
22.pickthall: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.
22.yusuf_ali: Then, when it is His Will, He will raise him up (again).
22.shakir: Then when He pleases, He will raise him to life again.
22.muhammad_sarwar: and He will resurrect him whenever He wants.
22.mohsin_khan: Then, when it is His Will, He will resurrect him (again).
22.arberry: then, when He wills, He raises him.

23.sahih_international: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
23.pickthall: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.
23.yusuf_ali: By no means hath he fulfilled what Allah hath commanded him.
23.shakir: Nay; but he has not done what He bade him.
23.muhammad_sarwar: Certainly, he has not duly fulfilled His commands.
23.mohsin_khan: Nay, but (man) has not done what He commanded him.
23.arberry: No indeed! Man has not accomplished His bidding.

24.sahih_international: Then let mankind look at his food -
24.yusuf_ali: Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it):
24.shakir: Then let man look to his food,
24.muhammad_sarwar: Let the human being think about (how We produce) his food.
24.mohsin_khan: Then let man look at his food,

25.sahih_international: How We poured down water in torrents,
25.pickthall: How We pour water in showers
25.yusuf_ali: For that We pour forth water in abundance,
25.shakir: That We pour down the water, pouring (it) down in abundance,
25.mohsin_khan: That We pour forth water in abundance,
25.arberry: We poured out the rains abundantly,

26.sahih_international: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
26.pickthall: Then split the earth in clefts
26.yusuf_ali: And We split the earth in fragments,
26.shakir: Then We cleave the earth, cleaving (it) asunder,
26.muhammad_sarwar: and let the earth to break open
26.mohsin_khan: And We split the earth in clefts,
26.arberry: then We split the earth in fissures

27.sahih_international: And caused to grow within it grain
27.pickthall: And cause the grain to grow therein
27.shakir: Then We cause to grow therein the grain,
27.mohsin_khan: And We cause therein the grain to grow,
27.arberry: and therein made the grains to grow

28.mohsin_khan: And grapes and clover plants (i.e. green fodder for the cattle),

29.shakir: And the olive and the palm,

30.yusuf_ali: And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees,
30.mohsin_khan: And gardens, dense with many trees,

32.sahih_international: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
32.pickthall: Provision for you and your cattle.
32.yusuf_ali: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
32.shakir: A provision for you and for your cattle.
32.muhammad_sarwar: (These are made so as to be) means of enjoyment for you and your cattle.
32.mohsin_khan: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.
32.arberry: an enjoyment for you and your flocks.

33.sahih_international: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
33.yusuf_ali: At length, when there comes the Deafening Noise,-
33.shakir: But when the deafening cry comes,
33.mohsin_khan: Then, when there comes As-Sakhkhah (the Day of Resurrection's second blowing of Trumpet),
33.arberry: And when the Blast shall sound,

34.sahih_international: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
34.pickthall: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
34.yusuf_ali: That Day shall a man flee from his own brother,
34.shakir: The day on which a man shall fly from his brother,
34.muhammad_sarwar: it will be such a day when a person will run away from his brother,
34.mohsin_khan: That Day shall a man flee from his brother,
34.arberry: upon the day when a man shall flee from his brother,

35.sahih_international: And his mother and his father
35.pickthall: And his mother and his father
35.yusuf_ali: And from his mother and his father,
35.shakir: And his mother and his father,
35.mohsin_khan: And from his mother and his father,

36.sahih_international: And his wife and his children,
36.pickthall: And his wife and his children,
36.yusuf_ali: And from his wife and his children.
36.shakir: And his spouse and his son--
36.mohsin_khan: And from his wife and his children.

37.sahih_international: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
37.pickthall: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).
37.yusuf_ali: Each one of them, that Day, will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to the others.
37.shakir: Every man of them shall on that day have an affair which will occupy him.
37.muhammad_sarwar: for on that day everyone will be completely engrossed in his own concerns.
37.mohsin_khan: Everyman, that Day, will have enough to make him careless of others.
37.arberry: every man that day shall have business to suffice him.

38.sahih_international: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
38.pickthall: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,
38.yusuf_ali: Some faces that Day will be beaming,
38.shakir: (Many) faces on that day shall be bright,
38.muhammad_sarwar: Some faces on that day will be radiant,
38.mohsin_khan: Some faces that Day, will be bright (true believers of Islamic Monotheism).
38.arberry: Some faces on that day shall shine

39.mohsin_khan: Laughing, rejoicing at good news (of Paradise).

40.sahih_international: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
40.pickthall: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,
40.yusuf_ali: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained,
40.shakir: And (many) faces on that day, on them shall be dust,
40.mohsin_khan: And other faces, that Day, will be dust-stained;
40.arberry: some faces on that day shall be dusty

42.sahih_international: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
42.pickthall: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
42.yusuf_ali: Such will be the Rejecters of Allah, the doers of iniquity.
42.shakir: These are they who are unbelievers, the wicked.
42.muhammad_sarwar: These will be the faces of the sinful disbelievers.
42.mohsin_khan: Such will be the Kafarah (disbelievers in Allah, in His Oneness, and in His Messenger Muhammad (Peace be upon him), etc.), the Fajarah (wicked evil doers).
42.arberry: those -- they are the unbelievers, the libertines.
